end.summary:
Practised ordering cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Yash gave 3 unaided correct orders across 6 attempts.
They explained that organs are made of several tissues, using the heart as an example.
They initially mixed up the heart with the circulatory system; this was not corrected after the last mention.
They identified amoeba as a single-celled organism without tissues or organs.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation with Yash using heart, digestive system, amoeba, and plant examples. They explained the sequence and later described how different tissues make an organ. The mix-up between the heart and the circulatory system was still present in the final plant example, so at home, ask them to make two labelled lists: organ (heart) and organ system (circulatory system), then draw the sequence once.
